title: RAMP KeyRevocationList
description: Emergency key-revocation snapshot served at WBAFile.revocation_url. Wire shape is protojson of ramp.v1.KeyRevocationList with UseProtoNames=true. Revoked entries are RFC 7638 thumbprints (base64url-no-pad).
$comment: revoked is NOT required: protojson with UseProtoNames omits an empty repeated field, so a 'nothing revoked' snapshot serializes to just {as_of}. Requiring revoked would reject that legitimate empty/cleared list. Absent revoked == empty revocation set.

revoked.$comment: Upper bound complements the 64 KiB body cap (which alone permits ~1400 thumbprints); no minItems since an empty/cleared list is legitimate (see top-level $comment).
